Acceptance criteria:
- AC1: Keystone loader. The only loading mark in the app is the arch with the keystone easing down and locking. It shows only after 1 second of waiting, so fast actions never flash it. [Brand, Rive] BIG (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 1)
- AC2: "Locked in" moments. The one-time keystone settle (planned for first layout publish) also marks the other two big commitments: a plan applied to Live and a Bridge flow going live. Still rare, never on routine saves. Refines SPEC 7. [Brand, Emil frequency rule] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 2)
- AC3: Cinnabar means committed. Cinnabar appears at most once per screen, and only where something has been locked in (the logo, the publish confirmation, the "live" seal). People learn the meaning without being told. [Brand section 2, JK one colour one meaning] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 3)
- AC4: The 15 degree rule. The keystone's 15 degree side angle is reused in tiny places: the ends of the active tab indicator, the notch on the "Draft" ribbon, the skeleton shimmer angle, the corner of the selected-card marker. One geometric rule everywhere is what makes Nothing and TE products recognisable. [Brand construction, Nothing] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 4)
- AC5: Voussoir progress. Multi-step work (Job Autopilot, Bulk Setup runs, Bridge backfill) shows progress as arch stones filling from both legs toward the top, with the keystone dropping last. [Brand, TE segmented displays] BIG (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 5)
- AC6: Arch health gauge. Database and integration health scores use a segmented arch instead of a generic donut. Missing stones show exactly which area is weak. [Brand, Apple Activity rings as precedent for an ownable gauge] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 6)
- AC7: Arch-masked bot avatars. Every Ingenium bot and Expert sits inside an arch-shaped mask; humans stay in circles. You can tell AI from people at a glance in any list, comment or history entry. Refines the planned avatar set. [Brand, Agentic] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 7)
- AC8: Stone grain. A barely visible limestone grain (about 2 percent) on large surfaces in light mode and a basalt grain in dark mode, so the app feels made of material, not flat pixels. Off in high contrast. [TE, Things, Family] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 8)
- AC9: Living favicon. The tab icon gets a tiny count when approvals wait, and the keystone dims while a long run is in progress, so you can work in another tab and still know. [Figma, Slack, Vercel] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 11)
- AC10: A type family with character. Page titles in Libre Franklin 600 (the wordmark's own family), the interface in a refined grotesque such as Geist or Onest instead of plain Inter, and a mono face for technical names. Three faces, no more. [Playbook 3, Brand 6, Taste] BIG (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 12)
- AC11: Technical names as quiet mono chips. Wherever an Odoo technical name appears (res.partner, x_delivery_date), it is set in mono, slightly smaller and muted, with one-click copy. Pairs with the planned term card. [Stripe docs, Vercel] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 13)
- AC12: Slashed zero in references. Record references and IDs (SO0091, INV/2026/0042) use the slashed-zero form so O and 0 never get confused. [JK typography, Stripe] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 14)
- AC13: Money set properly. The Naira sign gets a proper fallback and sits on the digit baseline, decimals are a shade lighter (1,250.00 with .00 muted), and amounts align on the decimal point in tables. [Playbook 3 currency note, Stripe] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 15)
- AC14: Rolling digits. When a number changes (records affected, money saved by caching, queue size), each digit rolls on its own instead of the whole number flashing. [Family, Robinhood, WMD] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 16)
- AC15: Size-specific tracking tokens. Titles tighter, body neutral, small caps labels opened up, so every size reads as designed rather than scaled. [Playbook 3, JK typography] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 17)
- AC16: all 162 design touches implemented in full; built ones re-checked inside their area rebuild (source: ledger UIX-TOUCHES, Tope 21 Oct; DESIGN_TOUCHES)
